8.3.8 SecOC_TpCancelReceive
[SWS_SecOC_91010]⌈
Service Name
SecOC_TpCancelReceive
Syntax
Std_ReturnType SecOC_TpCancelReceive (
PduIdType RxPduId
)
Service ID [hex]
0x4c
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Non Reentrant
Parameters (in)
RxPduId
Identification of the PDU to be cancelled.
Parameters
(inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: Cancellation was executed successfully by the
destination module.
E_NOT_OK: Cancellation was rejected by the destination
module.
Description
Requests cancellation of an ongoing reception of a PDU in a lower layer
transport protocol module.
Available via
SecOC.h
⌋()
